source_window.dataset_title: Geospatial Data Catalogue: HM Land Registry
source_window.resource_title: GOV.UK CSV preview — National Polygon / INSPIRE publication and constraint rows
source_window.data_date: GOV.UK Geospatial Data Catalogue CSV preview accessed 2026-10-06; catalogue publication page last updated 2020-10-01
source_window.license: Open Government Licence (OGL) for the catalogue; underlying datasets may have different licences.

field_evidence.catalogue_scope: HM Land Registry's Geospatial Data Catalogue is an index of electronic geospatial data linked to location through title registrations.
field_evidence.national_polygon_publication_status: The National Polygon Dataset row describes freehold and leasehold registration indexing, says every title has at least one index polygon, and marks the data as published/available under licence as part of the National Polygon Service.
field_evidence.national_polygon_fields_semantics: The catalogue describes index polygon extents and registered title extent as indicative position/extent information and directs users to the Title Plan and Title Register for full details.
field_evidence.inspire_publication_status: The INSPIRE Index Polygons row is published and publicly available, but its polygon extents are also described as indicative of title registration.
field_evidence.metadata_only_limit: The catalogue is metadata/publication-status information. It does not return a Forge Cottage Title_No, Poly_ID, Shape, INSPIRE ID, registered-title record, parcel geometry or parcel bbox.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No catalogue row or indicative index-polygon semantics are promoted to a canonical parcel. Target-specific title/parcel binding and any spatial join/materialization remain local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's unused public Geospatial Data Catalogue window confirms that the National Polygon Dataset is a published, licensed source containing index-polygon/title relationships and that INSPIRE Index Polygons are published, but the catalogue is metadata only and exposes no Forge Cottage Title_No, Poly_ID, Shape, INSPIRE ID, registered-title polygon or bbox. The catalogue also states index-polygon extents are indicative and the Title Plan and Title Register should be consulted for full details. Local OpenCode or authorised HM Land Registry access must bind the exact target title/parcel geometry and canonical bbox; after that, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to that bbox.
exact_blocker: The half-finished batch_047 method is completed by materially changing from the National Polygon technical-specification field/access window to HM Land Registry's Geospatial Data Catalogue publication-status/constraint window. The official public/no-login catalogue confirms the relevant spatial datasets and publication/access status but contains no target record or machine-readable Forge Cottage parcel geometry. It also confirms that index polygon extents are indicative rather than exact title-plan extent. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
